scope: Five research/deployment tracks supplement the immutable original21 protocol. These tracks do not redefine or pass its unmet requirements.

engineering.requirement: Preserve input, coordinate/resource ownership and bin restrictions. Additive explanations leave original predictions byte-identical and do not create reactions.

discovery_and_identity.requirement: Trace every saved127identityFN and33real candidates. Report first and joint reasons, precision/recall/abstention with scope; distinguish uncalibrated family sequence support from canonical calibrated_high.
discovery_and_identity.new_branch_status: Uncalibrated developmental sequence support only. No inherited precision from the original rule.

sites_and_modules.requirement: Report center compatibility, exact FeS uncertainty, module profiles and candidate composition independently. A missing architecture rule is not an absent query subunit.
sites_and_modules.profile_scope: Passing reviewed NAD/NuoF/flavin profiles within assigned module coordinates supports a fold/profile annotation; it does not establish cofactor selectivity or turnover. A profile on an unselected candidate partner is reported separately.

function_prediction.requirement: Output each property at its supported resolution with explicit dependencies. Evaluate per-property precision, recall and abstention only where truth is available. Do not turn unsupported or untested properties into negatives.
function_prediction.current_limited_delivery: Associated electron-transfer modules and nucleotide/flavin domain profiles. Specific new NAD/NADP selectivity and obligatory Fd coupling rules are not validated.
function_prediction.remaining_target: Freeze and validate non-exact-reference functional transfer in a bounded experimentally represented family; report coverage and error tradeoff.

deployment.MAG_pilot: Deferred by the human user; not a method output gate or a passed original requirement.
deployment.population_FPR: No 1e-6 population claim without representative independent negative evidence.
deployment.formal_release: Not achieved. Research outputs with explicit evidence bounds may be delivered.

data_usage.955_development: Exposed development comparison and ablation only; genotype/label evidence tiers retained.
data_usage.historical127_FN: Existing saved errors now used for development attribution; no new sequence prediction. Not a new final test for any revised rule.
data_usage.new_final_test: Must be fixed after rule freeze and exclude development/exposure sources and homolog/taxonomic leakage. Not yet claimed complete.
